description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] based on element of entry damage, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Steiner] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Steiner
description.text: Increases [Fire/Ice/Lightning Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Steiner when another ally uses a Fire, Ice or Lightning ability (max 4), casts Spirit Attack: Steiner II after using three Spellblade abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spellblade+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Steiner
description.text: One single attack (0.59), Absolute Devotion +1 to user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Steiner v2
description.text: Grants [Spellblade +10% Boost 1] and [Quick Cast 1] with at least 0-1 Absolute Devotion, grants [Spellblade +30% Boost 1] and [Quick Cast 1] with at least 2-3 Absolute Devotion, grants [Spellblade +50% Boost 1], [Damage Cap +10000 1] and [Instant Cast 1] with at least 4+ Absolute Devotion to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
